# Function to calculate birth weight z-score spline for each estimand 

```{r spline_4knot, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

add_rcs_splines <- function(data, x_var, probs = c(0.1, 0.4, 0.6, 0.9)) {
 
  x_vector <- data %>% pull({{ x_var }})
  knots_4 <- quantile(x_vector, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE)
  spline_matrix <- rcspline.eval(x_vector, knots = knots_4, inclx = TRUE)
  spline_df <- as.data.frame(spline_matrix)
  base_name <- deparse(substitute(x_var)) 
  colnames(spline_df) <- paste0(base_name, 1:ncol(spline_df))
  return(bind_cols(data, spline_df))
  
}

```

# S6: Time to discharge alive from tertiary hospital (censored at 52 w PMA, proportional hazards model)

```{r Estimand_S6, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
## duration of hospital stay - time tp discharge alive or tf to level 2 hospital, censored at 52 weeks****

#Missing date of discharge from tertiary hospital due to IE.3 or IE.4 will be censored at the date of withdrawal or
#date of last known contact with research staff. Missing date of discharge alive due to death (IE.7)
#during hospital stay will be censored at 52.0 weeks PMA

data_S6 <- data_elig %>%
  dplyr::select(study_id, rand.dfor.correct, dth_yn, dob.dfor, wd.dfor, dcgdtm.dfor, ga_calc, death_52wpma, recr_hosp.factor, ga_strata.f,
                withdraw_52wpma, Birth_weight_Z, rand_gp, multiple, ans.factor, sex) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Calculate the difference between two dates in weeks
    chron_age_rand = as.numeric(difftime(rand.dfor.correct, dob.dfor, units = "weeks")),
    chron_age_wd = as.numeric(difftime(wd.dfor, dob.dfor, units = "weeks")),
    chron_age_dc = as.numeric(difftime(dcgdtm.dfor, dob.dfor, units = "weeks")),
    # 2. Add those weeks to a third date (converted to weeks for proper addition)
    entry_pma = ga_calc + chron_age_rand,
    wd_pma = ga_calc + chron_age_wd,
    discharge_pma = ga_calc + chron_age_dc,
    # 3. Event
    discharged_miss_reason = case_when(!is.na(dcgdtm.dfor) ~ 0, #0 = date present
                                       death_52wpma == 1 ~ 1, #dth at 52PMA
                                       withdraw_52wpma == 1 ~ 2, #wd at 52PMA
                                       .default = 3),  #3 = unknown
    discharged_52pma = case_when((discharged_miss_reason == 0 & discharge_pma <= 52) ~ 1, 
                                 (discharged_miss_reason == 0 & discharge_pma > 52) ~ 0,
                                 discharged_miss_reason == 1 ~ 0,
                                 discharged_miss_reason == 2 ~ 0,
                                 discharged_miss_reason == 3 ~ NA,
                                 .default = NA
                                 ),
    # 4. exit_pma
    exit_pma = case_when(discharged_52pma == 1 ~ discharge_pma, 
                         (discharged_miss_reason == 0 & discharge_pma > 52) ~ 52,
                         discharged_miss_reason == 1 ~ 52,
                         discharged_miss_reason == 2 ~ wd_pma,
                         discharged_miss_reason == 3 ~ NA,
                         .default = NA
                         )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, Birth_weight_Z, sex,recr_hosp.factor) %>%
data_S6 <- data_S6 %>%
  add_rcs_splines(x_var = Birth_weight_Z, probs = c(0.1, 0.4, 0.6, 0.9))


fit_S6 <- coxph(Surv(time = entry_pma, time2 = exit_pma, event = discharged_52pma) ~ rand_gp + multiple + ans.factor + ga_strata.f + sex + strata(recr_hosp.factor) + Birth_weight_Z1 + Birth_weight_Z2 + Birth_weight_Z3, 
                data = data_S6[which(data_S6$exit_pma > data_S6$entry_pma),])
fit_summary_6 <- summary(fit_S6)

# Marginal effects: risk
set.seed(245679640)
S6_risk_marginal_ratio <- avg_comparisons(fit_S6, variables = "rand_gp", type = "risk", comparison = "ratio") |>
  inferences(method = "fwb", R = 1000) #produces the hazard relative 

S6_tab_marginal <- tidy(S6_risk_marginal_ratio)
#S6_tab_marginal_ratio$p.value <-  2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(S6_tab_marginal_ratio$estimate / S6_tab_marginal_ratio$std.error)))

aHR <- round(exp(coef(fit_S6)["rand_gp"]), digits = 2)
conf_int <- round(exp(confint(fit_S6, "rand_gp")), digits = 2)
cat("95% CI for difference:", conf_int[1], "to", conf_int[2], "\n")
Lower_95_CI <- conf_int[1] 
Upper_95_CI <- conf_int[2] 
p_value_raw_6  <- round(fit_summary_6$coefficients["rand_gp", "Pr(>|z|)"], digits = 3)
marg_Lower_95_CI = round((S6_tab_marginal$conf.low), digits = 2)
marg_Upper_95_CI = round((S6_tab_marginal$conf.high), digits = 2)
marg_HR <- round((S6_tab_marginal$estimate), digits = 2)
p_value_6 <- round(S6_tab_marginal[,5], digits = 3)

target_variable <- "rand_gp"

results_6 <- data.frame(
  estimate = aHR,
  Lower_95_CI = Lower_95_CI,
  Upper_95_CI = Upper_95_CI,
  p_value = p_value_raw_6,
  marg_HR <- marg_HR,
  marg_Lower_95_CI = marg_Lower_95_CI,
  marg_Upper_95_CI = marg_Upper_95_CI,
  p_value = p_value_6
)

results_6 <- results_6 %>%
rename(marg_estimate = marg_HR....marg_HR)

print(results_6)

# Reference Profile for covariates; select participant closest to zero BW z-score for spline
target_z_score <- 0
closest_index <- which.min(abs(data_S6$Birth_weight_Z - target_z_score))
ref_Z1 <- data_S6$Birth_weight_Z1[closest_index]
ref_Z2 <- data_S6$Birth_weight_Z2[closest_index]
ref_Z3 <- data_S6$Birth_weight_Z3[closest_index]


ref_grid6.2 <- data.frame( #baseline in the control group
      rand_gp          = rep(c(0, 1), 2),
      multiple         = 0,
      ans.factor       = factor(levels(data_S6$ans.factor)[1], levels = levels(data_S6$ans.factor)),
      ga_strata.f      = rep(c(factor(levels(data_S6$ga_strata.f)[1], levels = levels(data_S6$ga_strata.f)),
                               factor(levels(data_S6$ga_strata.f)[2], levels = levels(data_S6$ga_strata.f))), each = 2),
      sex             = 0,
      recr_hosp.factor = factor(levels(data_S6$recr_hosp.factor)[1], levels = levels(data_S6$recr_hosp.factor)),
      Birth_weight_Z1  = ref_Z1,
      Birth_weight_Z2  = ref_Z2,
      Birth_weight_Z3  = ref_Z3
 )

    # Adjusted median survival times

adj_curves6.2 <- survfit(fit_S6, newdata = ref_grid6.2)

    # Upper limit for restricted mean survival time
max_tau <- min(
      max(data_S6$exit_pma[data_S6$rand_gp == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
      max(data_S6$exit_pma[data_S6$rand_gp == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
)

    # Extract relative effect (aHR), for CIs, replace with your actual lower/upper boundaries from your fwb bootstrap
hr_est  <- round(S6_risk_marginal_ratio$estimate, digits = 2)
hr_lci  <- marg_Lower_95_CI
hr_uci  <- marg_Upper_95_CI

    # Medians (Using the safe quantile method)
medians <- quantile(adj_curves6.2, probs = 0.5)
med_c1   <- round(medians$quantile[1], 1)
med_i1   <- round(medians$quantile[2], 1)
med_c2   <- round(medians$quantile[3], 1)
med_i2  <- round(medians$quantile[4], 1)
med_diff1 <- round(med_i1 - med_c1, 1)
med_diff2 <- round(med_i2 - med_c2, 1)

    # Fixed Probabilities at 40 Weeks
prob_summary <- summary(adj_curves6.2, times = 40)
prob_c1       <- round(prob_summary$surv[1] * 100, 1)
prob_i1       <- round(prob_summary$surv[2] * 100, 1)
prob_c2       <- round(prob_summary$surv[3] * 100, 1)
prob_i2       <- round(prob_summary$surv[4] * 100, 1)
prob_diff1    <- round(prob_i1 - prob_c1, 1)
prob_diff2    <- round(prob_i2 - prob_c2, 1)

    # RMST (Using the internal matrix tool)
calc_matrix <- survival:::survmean(adj_curves6.2, rmean = max_tau)$matrix
rmst_c1      <- round(calc_matrix[1, "rmean"], 1)
rmst_i1      <- round(calc_matrix[2, "rmean"], 1)
rmst_c2      <- round(calc_matrix[3, "rmean"], 1)
rmst_i2      <- round(calc_matrix[4, "rmean"], 1)
rmst_diff1   <- round(rmst_i1 - rmst_c1, 1)
rmst_diff2   <- round(rmst_i2- rmst_c2, 1)

 # Combine results and format for reporting
results_df_6.2 <- tibble::tribble(
     ~Section, ~Metric, ~Stratum, ~Control, ~Intervention, ~Effect, ~P_Value,

        # Section 1: Relative
     "Relative Treatment Effect", "Marginal Risk Ratio","", "Reference (1.0)", "—", paste0(hr_est, " (", hr_lci, " to ", hr_uci, ")"), paste0(p_value_6),
     

        # Section 2: Absolute
      "Absolute Time Metrics", "Median Time to Discharge Home Alive (Weeks)", "1", as.character(med_c1), as.character(med_i1), paste0("Difference: ", med_diff1, " weeks"), "—",
      "Absolute Time Metrics", "", "2", as.character(med_c2), as.character(med_i2), paste0("Difference: ", med_diff2, " weeks"), "—",
      "Absolute Time Metrics", "Not yet Discharged at 40 Weeks PMA", "1", paste0(prob_c1, "%"), paste0(prob_i1, "%"), paste0("Risk Difference: ", prob_diff1, "%"), "—",
     "Absolute Time Metrics", "", "2", paste0(prob_c2, "%"), paste0(prob_i2, "%"), paste0("Risk Difference: ", prob_diff2, "%"), "—",
      "Absolute Time Metrics", "Restricted Mean Survival Time (RMST)", "1", paste0(rmst_c1, " weeks"), paste0(rmst_i1, " weeks"), paste0("RMST Difference: ", rmst_diff1, " weeks"), "-",
     "Absolute Time Metrics", "", "2", paste0(rmst_c2, " weeks"), paste0(rmst_i2, " weeks"), paste0("RMST Difference: ", rmst_diff2, " weeks"), "-"
     )

# Tabulate
        publication_table_6.2 <- results_df_6.2 %>%
          group_by(Section) %>%
          gt() %>%
          tab_header(title = md("**Table X: Analysis for Time to Tertiary Hospital Discharge**")) %>%
          cols_label(
              Metric = md("**Evaluation Metric**"),
              Stratum = md("**Stratum**"),
              Control = md("**Control Group**"),
              Intervention = md("**Intervention Group**"),
              Effect = md("**Treatment Effect Estimate (95% Confidence Interval)**"),
              P_Value = md("**P_Value**")
        ) %>%
        cols_align(align = "left", columns = Metric) %>%
        cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Stratum, Control, Intervention, Effect, P_Value)) %>%
        tab_footnote(
          footnote = "Stratum 1 = <28 weeks PMA, Stratum 2 = 28-32 weeks PMA.",
          locations = cells_column_labels(columns = Stratum)) %>%
         tab_footnote(
          footnote = "Adjusted for treatment allocation, multiplicity, maternal antenatal steroids, gestational age stratum, infant sex, recruiting centre, and birth weight z-score modeled via a natural cubic spline matrix. Confidence intervals are derived from a fractional weighted bootstrap (fwb) with 1,000 replications.",
          locations = cells_body(columns = Metric, rows = 1)) %>%
        tab_footnote(
          footnote = paste0("Restricted to a maximum follow-up horizon (tau) of ", round(max_tau, 1), " weeks post-menstrual age."),
          locations = cells_body(columns = Metric, rows = 4)) %>%
        tab_options(
          row_group.font.weight = "bold",
          table.border.top.color = "black",
          table.border.top.width = px(2),
          table.border.bottom.color = "black",
          table.border.bottom.width = px(2),

          column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
          column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(1.5),
          heading.border.bottom.style = "none"
        )

    upper_discharge  = 1 - lower  # Lower survival threshold becomes upper discharge bound
  )

# Ensure the facets follow a logical chronological layout (left to right)
curve_data$ga_strata.f <- factor(curve_data$ga_strata.f, 
                                 levels = c("<28 weeks PMA", "28-<32 weeks PMA"))

# 3. DYNAMICALLY FORCE VISUAL 0% START AT THE EARLIEST DATA POINT
# Finds the exact earliest time recorded for each stratum configuration
baseline_anchors <- curve_data %>%
  group_by(rand_gp, ga_strata.f) %>%
  slice(1) %>% 
  mutate(
    time = time,           # Keeps the true earliest observed time point
    cum_discharge = 0,     # Dynamically forces cumulative discharge rate to exactly 0%
    lower_discharge = 0,   # Set matching zero-error thresholds
    upper_discharge = 0
  )

# Combine the dynamic start positions with your actual data curves
curve_data_anchored <- bind_rows(baseline_anchors, curve_data6) %>%
  arrange(ga_strata.f, rand_gp, time)


# 4. Render the Publication-Quality Faceted Plot Matrix
plot6 <- ggplot(curve_data_anchored, aes(x = time, y = cum_discharge, color = rand_gp, fill = rand_gp)) +
  # Continuous step geometric paths for survival representations
  geom_step(size = 1) +
  # Shaded 95% Confidence Interval Ribbons
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_discharge, ymax = upper_discharge), alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
  
  # Generate isolated side-by-side panels for each GA stratum
  facet_wrap(~ga_strata.f) +   
  
  # Apply professional, colorblind-friendly medical hex palettes
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#1F77B4", "#D62728")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#1F77B4", "#D62728")) +
  
  # Continuous scale cleaning (Y-axis remains 0% to 100%)
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), 
                     limits = c(0, 1), 
                     expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  
  # Set x-axis range dynamically across the full breadth of data
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  
  # Labels and Structural Typography
  labs(
    x = "Weeks PMA",
    y = "Cumulative Probability of Discharge",
    color = NULL,
    fill  = NULL
  ) +
  
  # Minimalist Journal Theme Overrides (Nature/Elsevier Standard)
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text          = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.title       = element_blank(),                       
    legend.background  = element_blank(),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#F2F2F2", color = NA), 
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, color = "black"), 
    panel.spacing      = unit(1.5, "lines") 
  )

# Display the plot
print(plot6)

ggsave(

  height = 6,              # Standard height (inches)

)
```

The data for these time-to-event estimands included the randomised eligible trial participants (N = 744). Of these participants, 42 were missing their date of tertiary hospital discharge: 38 of these participants had withdrawn from the study (censored at date of withdrawal), 3 had died (censored at 52 weeks PMA) and 1 was missing their date of tertiary hospital discharge. 1 participant had a missing value for the birth weight Z-score and was excluded as this is a co-variate.

On average, participants in the intervention group face a 21% hazard of tertiary hospital discharge occurring at any given point in time compared to the control group (marginally averaged hazard ratio= 1.21; 95% CI: 1.06 to 1.41; p = <0.001).

The hazard ratio (HR) and the marginal risk ratio (RR) address different questions. The HR indicates the difference in rate of tertiary hospital discharge across the whole time period. The RR indicates the average ratio in the cumulative probability of tertiary hospital discharge at the specific time point of discharge between the study groups.

The intervention group was discharged from a tertiary hospital at a median time of approximately 0.5 weeks (3.5 days) less than the control group, they had a 6.9% less probability of still being in a tertiary hospital than the control group at 42 weeks PMA, and had a mean survival time of being discharged from a tertiary hospital that was approximately 0.7 weeks (5 days) less than the control group.


```{r Estimand_ S7, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
## total duration of hospital (tertiary and Level 2) stay prior to discharge home alive for participants who survive to 52.0 w PMA, censored at 52.0 w PMA****


#Missing date of discharge from tertiary hospital due to IE.3 or IE.4 will be censored at the date of withdrawal or
#date of last known contact with research staff. Missing date of discharge alive due to death (IE.7)
#during hospital stay will be censored at 52.0 weeks PMA

#CD died in hospital after the age of 52wk PMA


data_S7 <- data_elig %>%
  dplyr::select(study_id, rand.dfor.correct, dob.dfor, BWZ_cat.f, Birth_weight_Z, BWZ_bin, wd.dfor,dischhome.dfor,ga_calc,death_52wpma, recr_hosp.factor, ga_strata.f, withdraw_52wpma, rand_gp, multiple, ans.factor, sex) %>%
   mutate(
    # 1. Calculate the difference between two dates in weeks
    chron_age_rand = as.numeric(difftime(rand.dfor.correct, dob.dfor, units = "weeks")),
    chron_age_wd = as.numeric(difftime(wd.dfor, dob.dfor, units = "weeks")),
    chron_age_dc = as.numeric(difftime(dischhome.dfor, dob.dfor, units = "weeks")),
    # 2. Add those weeks to a third date (converted to weeks for proper addition)
    entry_pma = ga_calc + chron_age_rand,
    wd_pma = ga_calc + chron_age_wd,
    discharge_pma = ga_calc + chron_age_dc,
    # 3. Event
    discharged_miss_reason = case_when(!is.na(dischhome.dfor) ~ 0, #0 = date present
                                       death_52wpma == 1 ~ 1, #dth at 52PMA
                                       withdraw_52wpma == 1 ~ 2, #wd at 52PMA
                                       .default = 3),  #3 = unknown
    discharged_52pma = case_when((discharged_miss_reason == 0 & wd_pma < discharge_pma) ~ 0,
                                 (discharged_miss_reason == 0 & discharge_pma <= 52) ~ 1, 
                                 (discharged_miss_reason == 0 & discharge_pma > 52) ~ 0,
                                 discharged_miss_reason == 1 ~ 0,
                                 discharged_miss_reason == 2 ~ 0,
                                 discharged_miss_reason == 3 ~ NA,
                                 .default = NA
                                 ),
    # 4. exit_pma
    exit_pma = case_when(discharged_52pma == 1 ~ discharge_pma, 
                         (discharged_miss_reason == 0 & discharge_pma > 52) ~ 52,
                         discharged_miss_reason == 1 ~ 52,
                         discharged_miss_reason == 2 ~ wd_pma,
                         discharged_miss_reason == 3 ~ NA,
                         .default = NA
                         )) %>%
    #5. exclude the rows with missing
    tidyr::drop_na(rand_gp, ga_strata.f, multiple, ans.factor, BWZ_cat.f, sex, recr_hosp.factor,
                   entry_pma, exit_pma,discharged_52pma) 
  

fit_S7 <- coxph( Surv(entry_pma, exit_pma, discharged_52pma) ~ rand_gp + multiple + ans.factor + strata(ga_strata.f) + sex + strata(recr_hosp.factor) + strata(BWZ_cat.f), 
                 data = data_S7[which(data_S7$exit_pma > data_S7$entry_pma),])


fit_summary_7 <- summary(fit_S7)

    # Marginal effects: risk
#S7_risk_marginal <- avg_comparisons(fit_S7, variables = "rand_gp", type = "risk", vcov = "fwb", R = 1000)
set.seed(24372640)
S7_risk_marginal <- avg_comparisons(fit_S7, variables = "rand_gp", type = "risk", comparison = "ratio") |>
  inferences(method = "fwb", R = 1000)

S7_tab_marginal <- tidy(S7_risk_marginal)

    
aHR <- round(exp(coef(fit_S7)["rand_gp"]), digits = 2)
conf_int <- round(exp(confint(fit_S7, "rand_gp")), digits = 2)
cat("95% CI for difference:", conf_int[1], "to", conf_int[2], "\n")
Lower_95_CI <- conf_int[1] 
Upper_95_CI <- conf_int[2] 
p_value_raw_7  <- round(fit_summary_7$coefficients["rand_gp", "Pr(>|z|)"], digits = 3)
marg_Lower_95_CI = round((S7_tab_marginal$conf.low), digits = 2)
marg_Upper_95_CI = round((S7_tab_marginal$conf.high), digits = 2)
##p_value <- S6_risk_marginal$p.value

target_variable <- "rand_gp"

results_7 <- data.frame(

)

print(results_7)
```

The data for these time-to-event estimands included the randomised eligible trial participants (N = 744). Of these participants, 55 were missing their date of discharge home: 42 of these participants had withdrawn from the study (censored at date of withdrawal), 10 had died (censored at 52 weeks PMA) and 2 were missing their date of discharge home alive. 1 participant had a missing value for the birth weight Z-score and was excluded as this is a co-variate.

On average, participants in the intervention group face a 18% hazard of discharge home alive occurring at any given point in time compared to the control group (marginal risk ratio= 1.20; 95% CI: 1.03 to 1.45; p = <0.001)
